item.title: Police used AI facial recognition to wrongly arrest TN woman for crimes in ND
item.description:
📝 Angela Lipps, 50, was first arrested in Tennessee on July 14, according to a statement from the Fargo Police Department and a verified GoFundMe for Lipps. Clearview “identified a potential suspect with similar features to Angela Lipps” and West Fargo police shared that report with Fargo police, reads a statement from the police department. The statement notes that West Fargo police didn’t forward any charges and didn’t have enough evidence to charge anyone for the fraud case in West Fargo.
🔗 Read more: https://www.cnn.com/2026/03/29/us/angela-lipps-ai-facial-recognition

item.title: Patriot Crisis: US Embezzles Switzerland's Fighter Jet Funds
item.description:
📝 Officials say this structure allows Washington to reallocate funds between procurement programmes. In this case, money originally intended for Switzerland’s F-35 fighter jet programme has reportedly been used to cover shortfalls in the Patriot missile system contract. This brings the total estimated cost to approximately CHF 3 billion, further straining Switzerland’s defence budget.
